messages:
alice: Heads-up — Prod change window tomorrow 2024-05-17 12:00-14:00 UTC for v2.3 launch. Please ack if you own a rollout task or monitoring. Freeze at 11:30 UTC. Checklist below.

alice: Quick TL;DR checklist:
• pin images/configs
• release notes published
• canary + smoke tests defined
• rollback plan + tags ready
• on-call & paging confirmed
• no infra changes after freeze (exceptions: P0)

ben: Ack. I'll own the deploy and canary.

carol: Ack. I own monitoring/dashboards + alert thresholds. Will update runbook.

elaine: I'll publish release notes & changelog by EOD. Draft at https://internal.redwood/docs/releases/v2.3-draft (will push final link).

dinesh: Pinning runtime images: model-serving -> sha256:3a7b9f..., api-backend -> sha256:8c2f1d...
Also: DB migration is guarded flag; will run --check before deploy.

deploy-bot: Scheduling deploy window for 2024-05-17 12:00 UTC. To cancel: `/deploy cancel 1716004823`

alice: Freeze reminder — NO schema changes or infra rolling restarts after 11:30 UTC. If you need an exception tag it with @alice and reason.

ben: Canary plan: 5% traffic 00:10m -> monitor errors/latency -> 25% 00:20m -> 100% after manual ok. Manual approval required at 25% by @alice or @carol.

carol: Monitoring checklist:
• latency p50/p95 dashboards updated
• error budget alert at 3% for canary window
• anomaly detection enabled for request spikes
• synthetic heartbeat every 30s: `curl -sS -H "x-api-key:smoke" https://api.redwood.ai/health` expect 200

dinesh: Migration plan: `./migrate --check` then `./migrate --apply --no-backfill` if check passes. If migration adds indexes with >5s locks, abort.

elaine: Release notes will include upgrade table, pinned image SHAs, rollback steps, and contact list. Putting final link in channel when ready.

alice: Rollback rules: If error rate >5% sustained for 10m OR any P1 incident, trigger rollback to tag `stable-20240510` (v2.2). Rollback command: `kubectl set image deploy/api api-backend=registry/redwood:stable-20240510` then scale down canary.

ben: Confirmed I have the rollback tag and runbook. Will run dry-run of rollback commands in staging tonight.

sre-oncall: I'm on-call for the window and reachable. Pager rotation: @sre-oncall then @dinesh for infra.

carol: Smoke test script (shared in runbook):
```
# smoke.sh
TOKEN=smoke-token
for i in 1 2 3; do
  curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/ping || exit 1
done
```
Expect 200 responses and avg latency <250ms.

ben: Note: pin feature flags for v2.3 in FF service before deploy: `ffctl pin release_v2_3 true`

alice: Final signoffs required by 11:15 UTC: deploy owner (ben), monitoring (carol), migrations (dinesh), release notes (elaine), on-call (sre-oncall). Reply with :thumbsup: when signed off.

carol: :thumbsup: monitoring ready.

dinesh: :thumbsup: migrations and images pinned.

elaine: :thumbsup: release notes published https://internal.redwood/docs/releases/v2.3-final

ben: :thumbsup: deploy checklist done, canary hooks configured.

deploy-bot: Deploy started at 2024-05-17 12:00:10 UTC for thread 1716004823 — canary 5% rolling.

carol: Observability note: small spike in p95 at +02m, investigating, looks like gc pause on one node. Will watch.

ben: Canary at 5% -> no increased errors after 10m. Promoting to 25% (awaiting manual approval).

alice: Approving promotion to 25%.

deploy-bot: Canary promoted to 25% at 12:12:45 UTC.

carol: At +18m error rate creeping to 2.8% p50 latency still fine. Keeping watch.

ben: Proceeding to 100% in 10m if no regressions.

sre-oncall: If errors cross 5% for 10m we rollback. I'm watching alerts.

deploy-bot: Deploy completed to 100% at 12:34:10 UTC — tag v2.3. Metrics available on dashboard #dash/releases/v2.3

alice: Launch checklist executed. Thanks team. Postmortem follow-up: collect any minor regressions and open tickets.

elaine: Publishing public release notes draft for marketing review.

ben: Leaving a short deploy note in release log: "v2.3 rollout 2024-05-17, canary 5->25->100, no rollback."

carol: Will update runbook with one-off GC mitigation for node.

alice: Closing change window. If anyone needs an exception for post-launch tweaks, file it here with justification. :rocket:
